rationale: CHARACTERIZATION fixture for the last of the six regexes removed from this analyzer: the `name:` value was unquoted with a character class that stripped every quote anywhere in the value, and is now read with the file's existing `unquote` helper, which strips SURROUNDING quotes of either style. The two agree for a `name:` option, which is always a string literal, and F8 makes that load-bearing: the component's ONE identity is this name, every component-owned edge sources it, and the store's symbol key is name+line, so an unstripped quote would publish the component under a name containing quote characters, unreachable as a target for every edge that sources it. Only `vue/options-rename-identity` (single quotes) covered this path, so the double-quoted spelling was untested. `label` is interpolated and `go` is bound, so the fixture also proves the renamed identity still sources the delegated edges.

forbidSymbols.name: "DoubleQuoted"
forbidSymbols.note: an unstripped quote would publish the component under a name no edge can resolve
